summary_en: This study tests MQ710, a virus-based treatment (virotherapy) that is injected into tumors, alone or together with pembrolizumab, in people with advanced solid tumors, including skin cancers, melanoma, and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. MQ710 is injected directly into the tumor in multiple doses, and pembrolizumab 200 mg is given intravenously every 3 weeks in the combination group; how often MQ710 is given is not stated. This is a Phase 1 study, and its stated purpose is to find the highest dose of MQ710 that causes few or mild side effects.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa MQ710, un tratamiento basado en virus (viroterapia) que se inyecta en los tumores, solo o junto con pembrolizumab, en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados, incluidos cánceres de piel, melanoma y carcinoma de células escamosas de cabeza y cuello. MQ710 se inyecta directamente en el tumor en varias dosis, y en el grupo de combinación se administra pembrolizumab de 200 mg por vía intravenosa cada 3 semanas; la frecuencia de MQ710 no está indicada. Es un estudio de Fase 1, y su objetivo indicado es encontrar la dosis más alta de MQ710 que cause efectos secundarios leves o pocos.
who_for: Advanced or metastatic solid tumor that returned or worsened after prior treatment, or with no standard treatment available.
At least 2 tumors suitable for direct or ultrasound-guided injection, with at least one lesion 0.5 cm or larger.
Predicted life expectancy of 3 months or more.
not_for: Active infection needing antibiotics or physician monitoring.
Positive test for hepatitis B or hepatitis C, or HIV with CD4 count below 100.
Known active brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis.
Pregnant, breastfeeding, or expecting to conceive or father a child during the trial.
Need for anticoagulation therapy, such as warfarin, or known allergy to MQ710 transgene products or formulation.
cancer_types: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
